title: How would you estimate how many cups of coffee London cafés sell on a weekday?
description: A step-by-step estimate for "How many cups of coffee do London cafés sell on a weekday?" with the approach, the maths and a sanity check.
hook: A friendly one to start with: you have almost certainly bought a coffee in a city, so you already have the instincts. The interesting bit is how many people actually buy one on a given day. Have a go at your own estimate before reading on.
body:
The question

How many cups of coffee do London cafés sell on a weekday?

The approach

Demand side: people × share who buy café coffee that day × cups each.

Tip: Say your approach out loud before any numbers; it lets the interviewer agree or nudge you early.

Step by step

  1. People in London: 9M
  2. × 25% buy coffee from a café on a weekday
  3. × 1.5 cups each

That gives about 3.38M cups a day.

Does it make sense?

About 20,000 cafés and coffee counters would each sell around 170 cups a day, which sounds right for a busy city.
